quirks.lineage: Modular-architecture AVP build; menu skeleton identical to hummod_3.0.4 (Stop=6, Go 12-30, Trauma/Hemorrhage=741); verified by engine_smoke with the 3.0.4 profile. Ships Model Solver.exe + ScriptedController.exe.
quirks.app_title: HumMod : Integrative Biomedicine (v3.1.0) - the AVP engine is actually HumMod v3.1.0 (window title, verified 2026-11 R1 baseline run).
quirks.auto_profile_unreachable: _detect_profile matches its Trauma/Sizing menu to hummod_3.0.4, so this profile is only used when a server is started with HUMMOD_PROFILE=avphummod. Functionally harmless: menu ids and quirks are identical to 3.0.4 (R1 full-parameter run passed with the 3.0.4 profile).
